text: Implemented in bdd4b313c2abf7189a4a7db6c8387dafd696213c. Published SceneDeviceLaws, CoordinateInvolutionLaws, PlotLayoutLaws, and TargetRecompilationLaws; strengthened the canonical backend contract for square/triangle/cross primitives, point-unit stroke resolution, full text style, patterns, images, and group effects; and moved PDF from parse-only coverage to the same semantic deterministic checker used by the reference device, SVG, Canvas, Java2D, and JavaFX. Exact-tree evidence: scalafmtCheckAll passed; testAll passed 866 tests across all aggregated JVM and Scala.js projects.
